notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.1.0 + Dev Updates
notes.notes:
Hello gang! ^-^ In case you're not aware, we have released a small patch 2 days ago. Here's what you need to know about it:

 Patch Notes:

Various grammar fixes! (Forever ongoing!)
Chapter 7 Branch Tree Completion achievement bug is now fixed. To trigger the achievement, simply load a save file from Chapter 7 (preferably during a question, then choose any option).
Added several new branch tree nodes in Chapter 6. There's a certain scene in Ash's chapter that repeats several lines you've just read because the conditions were not checked properly. We had to add these new nodes (conditions) to fix that consistency problem. This fix should NOT affect your Chapter 6 Branch Tree Completion achievement (meaning if you've already unlocked the achievement before, it will remain unlocked). But for those of you who are ultimate completionists and would like to unlock all the nodes regardless, here's how you can unlock the new ones we've just added:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28198396/360306859e3756a195c08f051b0a308ad76e72d1.png
Right-click, open image in new tab for higher display. All the locked nodes in the screenshot above are the new branch tree nodes we've added.


The Letter is now available on iOS! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28198396/0501cd8f69c4d15a8739155ed97c05afc88861e5.jpg

Apple Users rejoice, because you can now play The Letter VN on your smart phones! ^_^

Download the game now!!
http://apple.co/2A5shiT

Chinese & Russian Translations are underway! 

Depending on the schedule of our translators, we're estimating we can release the Russian and Chinese versions by second or third quarter of 2018! Watch out for future announcements! ^^

Last but not the least...

The Autumn Sale is ending soon, so make sure you grab a copy of the game while the 25% off lasts! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28198396/83668a90f80af98b32f4dc04b93d66969f9770e8.jpg

notes.title: [Important] Patch Notes for v1.0.8
notes.notes:
Hello gang! We are aware of the various UI problems caused by the latest patch (v1.0.7). We are pushing the fix for this as we speak, and v1.0.8 should be available anytime now. 

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience this has caused. We are currently optimizing several of the game's systems for better performance, and in the process, accidentally nicked the wrong parts. We will be more careful next time. 

 Patch Notes for v1.0.8 

  Fixed various UI problems , such as: (a) Extras redirecting to Gallery. (b) Unclickable choices. (c) Messed-up journal layout. (d) And several other weird UI problems that seem to fix itself when the game is restarted.
  Re-polished the narrative of Chapter 1.  All reported grammar mistakes for Chapter 1 here on Steam and Discord should be fixed. We also rephrased some parts that are stilted, so hopefully they sound more natural now. Please let us know if there's anything else you find odd!
  Bug Fixing of Chapter 6.  All reported VA mismatch, branch tree nodes not unlocking, and bugs for Chapter 6 should be fixed! However, there are still some lines that don't have VA. We'll get to them soon! If we missed something, please let us know so we can correct them!
  Relationship Balancing.  [spoiler] Increased Isabella/Rebecca relationship from +1 to +2 when 'This cold caught up with me' & 'Is this why you didn't go home last night?' were selected in Chapter 5. [/spoiler] 

 What to expect for v1.0.9 

We have noticed several issues regarding the game's CGs/BGs, so please expect another patch from us soon. These issues include unobtainable Epilogue CGs, all CGs/BGs that have a vignette/flashback effect not displaying, and other Gallery-related bugs. 

v1.0.9 might come a few days from now. Please be a little more patient with us as we continue to squash these pesky bugs! =)

Thank you so much!

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.5 + Release Demo Now Live!
notes.notes:
He'ya gang! Sorry for the late announcement, but here are the patch notes for  v.1.0.5 !

 Fixed all reported branch tree nodes that were not unlocking.
 Fixed a couple of mismatched VA lines.
 Fixed a few dangling italic tags.
 Fixed an achievement that was impossible to unlock due to a wrong condition.
 Fixed a couple of wrong conditions at Chapter 7 (both text and branch tree).
 Improved the N scene at Chapter 1.
 Implemented a handle that prevents the game from getting stuck at the Disclaimer page if your PC/device improperly shuts down.
 Implemented 4k HD resolution 2560x1440 & 3840x2160, although this is still in beta. Please let us know if you find any problems with these resolutions!
 Implemented a fix that causes the save data to be wiped when you exit the game (only affects new players). v1.0.5 shouldn't have this problem anymore, but in case you want to recover your old save files, please e-mail john@yangyangmobile.com and we'll help you sort it out!

 Future Fixes 
Here are the things we're continuously improving, and might take some time to be 100% resolved:

 Grammar and VA mismatch with the text.
 Dangling italic tags.
 Lines that don't have VA. 
 Branch tree nodes not unlocking (only a few left!)

 Release Demo (Chapter 1) Now Available! 
For those who are still on the fence if they should buy the game, we have released the full Chapter 1 as a demo for you to try! Hopefully you'll like it! ^^

 What about Music Room? 
We plan to release a soundtrack DLC of the game in the near future, and the Music Room will unlock if you purchase the DLC. We will also provide an MP3 or WAV (not sure yet) version, so you can also listen to it even if you're not playing the game :)

Backers who pledged for Digital Deluxe and above will receive the soundtrack DLC as part of their campaign rewards!

 THANK YOU! 
Before we end this update, we just want to say a BIG THANK YOU to everyone who purchased the game, wrote reviews, reported bugs and supported us in general! :) We wouldn't have gotten this far without you all, and we're really glad you enjoyed the game despite the occasional bugs! Reading the positive reviews make us very happy, like you have no idea. XD

So... thank you!!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28198396/28e0c5b46691db5836ef5b4ca8aa5bad93b65769.jpg

notes.title: Big Patch Notes for v1.0.2!
notes.notes:
Hello gang!

We'll be pushing out a new patch today  (v.1.0.2)  that addresses the following things:

 Polishing & Proof-reading 

We are replaying the entire game and we're adding some more polishing/proof-reading to every scene. Because Chapters 6 and 7 are SO HUGE with lots and lots of combinations, the extra pass of polishing might take some time (if not months), so please expect frequent patches from us!

 Branching Tree & Loading Save Files 

We are aware that the branching trees of 6 and 7 are lagging. That's because they're super long. To begin with, we ourselves didn't expect the game to blow up like this, so the system was unable to handle it properly.

Our programmers have currently implemented a fix in this patch. Loading saved files should be faster now. But the compromise is opening the branch tree for the first time will be a bit slow (might take a couple of seconds). But once you re-open them it should be fast already. :) Switching from one branch tree chapter to another would also take time.

This is the best fix we can think of so far, but our technical director is still experimenting/thinking of ways on how to improve the player experience.

 Branching Tree Nodes not unlocking 

Chapters 6 and 7 have 4000 branch tree nodes combined, all of which we are manually unlocking via script. If you find a node that doesn't light up, please let us know ASAP so we can investigate and patch it on our end (please enable the "show debug info" and send us the scene no. + line no.)

Please take note that if you have a save file that has a problematic node, even if we patch it, it still wouldn't be unlocked when you reload it. Instead, you'll have to reload the previous scene that has a working node, and skip the part where your save file is, and then replace that save file. 

 Voice Acting & Epilogues 

This patch should also fix a couple of errors with voice acting. We are aware that some lines are still unvoiced, and they will be patched soon as well!

Any problems regarding the Epilogues should also be fixed now! Otherwise, please let us know!

 Avatars for everyone!! 

Phew, thank you for reading this far! We deeply apologize for any inconvenience, but rest assured we're working hard to fix every error you report as much as we can. (•̀o•́)ง

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28198396/6e8485a5e75dd4e9c91a59223f4faae00aac4815.jpg

Let's end this update on a lighter note! Here's a The Letter avatar pack for everyone! Time to change your display pictures!! ♡

 Avatar Pack: 
https://s3-ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/yangyangmobile/The+Letter+Avatar+Pack.zip

notes.title: Development + Release Update
notes.notes:
Hello gang! :) This is an important update because we will discuss our current progress during the last leg of development, as well as the game's release date.

 I. Development Update: 

All writing and major art assets are done! The last roadblocks we have to face are the scripting of the final two chapters, voice acting and quality assurance. Oh, and getting approved by Steam once we submit the final build to them.  

We can have everything squared out by this month, which leads us to…

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28198396/a1005c0e7ea9bf6c89606dc424a71675d62c0c9d.jpg

 II. Release Date: 

Even though the game will be finished this June, we will not be releasing it this month. We’re estimating the full game to be ready by late June, which is around the Steam Summer Sale. We do not want to release at the same time as one of Steam’s biggest seasonal sales.  

Of course, it also came to our mind to just rush the game’s development. Meaning, release it before the Steam Summer Sale drops (no VA & very rough/unfinished scripting of the last 2 chapters) and just patch the missing features/fixes within the first week of launch, hoping nobody has gotten that far yet. But this is going to be too chaotic, and in the end, we decided not to compromise the game’s quality on Day 1.

While we still can’t promise anything, the game will most likely be released in July. We have a magic date we’re looking forward to, but we’re not going to disclose it until we’re sure that it’s confirmed (Steam has approved our final build, and that everything is working/no game breaking bugs). As long as we don’t hit any other major roadblock, July is a positive month for us.

We're really sorry for the long wait, and we hope for your kind understanding!

------
